reader.reads: Aristotle, Poetics XXI, in the Greek public corpus, beside the register reading and its English and Russian translations.

thesis.ru: Аристотель определяет метафору как перенос чужого имени с рода на вид, с вида на род, с вида на вид или по аналогии.
thesis.en: Aristotle defines metaphor as the transfer of an alien name from genus to species, species to genus, species to species, or by analogy.
